# Lalor Dental Clinic

## About
Lalor Dental Clinic is a family dental and cosmetic clinic located in Lalor, Victoria 3075, Australia. Principal dentist Dr. Eyad Almashaal provides high-quality dental and aesthetic treatments to patients in Lalor, Thomastown, Epping, Bundoora, and surrounding northern suburbs of Melbourne.

## Services
- General dental check-ups and cleans
- Dental implants
- Teeth whitening (in-chair and take-home)
- Porcelain veneers
- Root canal treatment
- Dental crowns and bridges
- Tooth-coloured fillings
- Emergency dental care (same-day appointments)
- Family dentistry including children
- Cosmetic dentistry
- Anti-wrinkle injections (Botox)
- Dermal fillers
- Lip enhancement and contouring
- Skin rejuvenation treatments
